title: The List of Ten Thousand Years Ago
next_chapter_hook: The last page of the list slowly unfolded, and Chen Ji saw his ending—not defeated, not victorious, but becoming an option for the next Chess Player.

text.content: That voice pierced through the marrow like ten-thousand-year-old cold ice, yet carried an eerie familiarity: "You and I are birds of the same fate. Why not dance the final chess move with me?" Chen Ji felt the spiritual pressure around him suddenly dissipate, replaced by a chaotic void—he had been pulled into a realm beyond space. Countless golden runes suddenly lit up before his eyes,密密麻麻爬满整片虚空，汇聚成一卷绵延至视野尽头的巨大卷轴。

Chen Ji instinctively stepped back half a pace, yet found his legs bound as if by invisible chains. The scroll slowly unfurled, and in the golden light, his figure seemed as insignificant as a grain of sand. "Welcome to view the List of Ten Thousand Years Ago." The voice rang out again, and this time he finally recognized the source of that familiar feeling—it was his own voice, aged by ten thousand years.

dialogue.content: This is the chess game set by the Eye of Heavenly Providence. From the moment of your birth, every step of yours was written on this list. Struggle—the more intense your resistance, the more magnificent the chess game becomes.

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, staring fixedly at the scroll. The runes reorganized before his eyes, and he saw his own name—"Chen Ji, Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple, waste persona, actual Tianji Record inheritor." Beside the name, densely packed annotations filled the space: birth hour, family background, truth behind his parents' death, even the snowstorm from when he was three years old that nearly starved him to death. His entire life was actually a meticulously crafted script.

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) What an extensive list. Tell me, sir holding the pen, how much did the Tianqing Sect pay you to write me so miserably?

text.content: The runes continued scrolling, and more familiar names appeared beside Chen Ji's. "Chen Tianming, Tianqing Sect Sect Master, Chen Ji's father, List piece number three thousand seven hundred twenty-one, sacrificed in a mission fifteen years ago as arranged." His father did not die by accident. From the very beginning, he was meticulously disposed of waste material. And Chen Ji himself was chosen to be the vessel for carrying the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: (Pressing down on his slightly trembling fingers) The last words my father said before death, 'Ji'er, survive,' was that also a line you taught him?

text.content: The scroll continued to unfurl, names flickering past like a carousel. "Ye Qing, Demonic Path Saint Maiden, List piece number eight hundred ninety-two, adopted by the Holy Sect at age fifteen, arranged to meet Chen Ji three years later." Her background, her hatred, even the first words she said to Chen Ji were all written in advance on this list. So the so-called cooperation was merely another staged performance.

dialogue.content: (Suddenly bursting into laughter) Marvelous! I thought I was the one moving the pieces, turns out I was just a monkey running excitedly in a cage! May I ask, how many other monkeys are watching the show outside this cage?

text.content: The runes flickered, and a new line of text appeared: "Su Qingyao, Tianqing Sect Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, List piece number three thousand twenty-three, destined to form a bond with Chen Ji." Chen Ji's smile suddenly froze. He recalled every confrontation with Su Qingyao, every time she saw through his edge—it was all within the script. And her feelings for him were merely the plot requirements as set.

dialogue.content: (Voice suddenly turning ice-cold) Even her feelings for me were part of the written script? Sir holding the pen, you truly went to great lengths.

text.content: The scroll abruptly stopped, and a particularly eye-catching line of golden text floated before Chen Ji: "Mo Xiansheng, Tianji Record Guardian, one of the co-authors of the List, true stance unknown." Chen Ji felt a string in his mind snap. Mo Xiansheng—that existence in the residual soul form dwelling on the first page of the Tianji Record, the voice that unsealed a page of knowledge each time a volume's objective was completed—had actually been a co-author of this List?

dialogue.content: (Suddenly laughing loudly, yet the laughter filled with biting cold) What a guardian! What a master! Every time I sought answers from you, that hesitant look on your face—was you debating what to tell me and what to withhold? Ten thousand years of布局—you truly had patience!

text.content: A low sigh echoed from the depths of the void—it was his own voice, yet as ancient as a bell from ages past: "You've finally seen it. Beyond this List, there is one name that has never appeared—Chen Nian." Chen Ji's heart tightened suddenly. His sister's name was not on the List. What did this mean? Was she a variable outside the chess game, or had she not even qualified to be written into the List?

"A person not on the List is the true variable." The voice spoke again, this time carrying a barely perceptible note of praise. "I have waited ten thousand years for someone who could break this chess game. And you, have finally arrived at this step." The last page of the scroll slowly appeared, containing only two options, emanating a chilling glow.

choice.prompt: Facing the truth of the List of Ten Thousand Years Ago, Chen Ji must make a choice

choices.description: At the cost of consuming all Heavenly Fate, forcibly burn this List, turning the ten-thousand-year-old layout to ashes
choices.visible_reward: The underlying structure of ten thousand years collapses, a new chess game begins

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his hand, and the Tianji Record burned fiercely in his palm. He poured all his Heavenly Fate into that scroll, and the golden runes let out ear-piercing wails, collapsing one after another. The ten-thousand-year layout turned to ashes in this moment.

choices.visible_reward: Obtain partial modification rights to the List
choices.risk_hint: Forced tampering may trigger higher-level sanctions

text.content: A fierce light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He bit through his fingertip, using blood as ink, and wrote his own name on the scroll. In that moment, the runes trembled violently, as if resisting some indescribable force.

choices.description: Since everything was destined long ago, might as well see what lies at the endpoint of this chess game
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the truth of the List's final page
choices.risk_hint: May completely become a chess piece

text.content: Chen Ji slowly lowered his hand, the smile at the corner of his mouth even more难看 than crying. Since struggling was useless, let's just see how this play ends. He wanted to see how the scriptwriter would write the finale.

Just then, an ancient voice suddenly rang out—it was Mo Xiansheng, yet entirely different from his usual profound and enigmatic tone: "Foolish child! Have you still not understood?" On the scroll, beside Mo Xiansheng's name, a new line of text appeared: "Mo Xiansheng, actual identity: the residual soul of Chen Xuan, the previous generation Tianji Record inheritor, forced into complicity, true wish: for the inheritor to break the chess game."

Chen Ji stood frozen in place. Mo Xiansheng was not a collaborator but another chess piece trapped within the game? His master, his guide, was in fact a victim of this ten-thousand-year conspiracy just like himself? "I have been trapped in this Tianji Record for ten thousand years, able only to watch one inheritor after another being written into the List." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried infinite desolation. "And you—you are the only one who has walked to this step and can still stand there questioning this world."

The scroll abruptly disintegrated, and ten-thousand-year-old runes scattered like snowflakes. Chen Ji felt a majestic force surge into his body—that was the primal power after the Tianji Record's complete unsealing. Before his eyes appeared a blurry vision—Chen Nian imprisoned in pitch-black underground, wrapped in countless golden chains, gazing into the void with a pair of eyes identical to his own.

dialogue.content: (The momentum of his entire body changed abruptly, both fists clenched tight) My sister is not on the List, so she is the only variable in this chess game. What you showed me—was it because you want me to find her?

text.content: At the end of the void, a blurry figure slowly emerged—the本体 of the Eye of Heavenly Providence, yet Chen Ji could make out no facial features. "Find her, break the chess game, or..." the figure let out a low laugh, "become the new Chess Player." Before the words finished, Chen Ji felt the world spinning. When he opened his eyes again, he had returned to the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. And in his palm, clearly burned a line of scalding golden text: "Final choice: Breaker of the game, or successor."
